title: CGUSB-ST4 / NYX-101 ST4 DEC response is inverted relative to direct NYX guiding away from pole on both pier sides.
summary: At DEC +70 on NYX-101, CGUSB 0 moves south and 1 north relative to direct NYX n/s: reproduced on E/W with the original cable, and on E with the cable that gives expected 0=north/1=south on iEXOS-100. Same-cable NYX repeats are about -14.55/+14.529 arcsec for 2 s. The original cable alone cannot explain the difference. Isolate NYX ST4 input interpretation/configuration/firmware before remediation; owner requires unchanged driver mapping.
evidence: verification.md and orientation-probe.jsonl in task 20261024095945-ac63-verify-cgusbst4-dec-orientation; two repeats each of direct n/s and numeric 0/1, matched idle interval, stable pier side E; original park/settings restored.; W-side follow-up: task 20261024101137-d0d9-verify-cgusbst4-dec-west verification.md and west-orientation-probe.jsonl, two repeats per direction on stable W, MD-approved ordinary goto and exact original park/settings restored. iEXOS/cable comparison: task 20261024102929-75ee-verify-cgusbst4-iexos verification.md, iexos-orientation-probe.jsonl and measurement-summary.json; 480-query replacement-USB-cable stability pass, two repeats, original home restored within one RA microstep, tracking off. Same-cable NYX follow-up: task 20261024105327-f79c-verify-nyx-same-st4-cable same-cable-probe.jsonl, measurement-summary.json and verification.md. Nine intervals, stable E; parked/tracking-off/R6/DEC/target restored, exact RA counter differs by -80, explicitly accepted by owner; no park rewrite.
